consequence.statement: No operational consequence for a cert-manager installation: the update only adds the Kubernetes 1.33 node image to the project's own CI kind images, and the release note files it under 'Other (Cleanup or Flake)'.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 updates its CI kind images to include the Kubernetes 1.33 node image, a test-infrastructure change with no stated customer-facing effect.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence describes only an update to the project's CI kind node images (test infrastructure); it names no cert-manager Helm value, CRD field, image repository, flag, config key or version boundary that a deployed environment could hold, so no subject family applies.; applicability: The change affects the project's CI kind node images, which are not part of a deployed cert-manager installation and are not referenced by any customer environment state (no Helm value, manifest field, workload image, flag or version condition could expose it), so there is no environment condition to evaluate.
